# DoneRelay

> One local bundle with a complete Node.js runtime and agent skill for Telegram task notifications, bounded questions, and single-operation human approvals. Personal WeChat / Weixin is experimental.

Status: alpha source preview. Runs alongside Codex or Claude Code; guided private Telegram pairing and automatic local startup are included. No separate server or manual API connection setup. Partial real Telegram/Codex acceptance and isolated host installation checks are recorded in docs/LAUNCH.md; remaining launch gates are explicit. No official directory listing, hosted service, npm publication, or Codex Cloud compatibility is claimed. This optional index is not a search-ranking mechanism.

Slack self notifications can reuse the host's existing MCP connection without Telegram setup. Live Slack delivery remains unverified; Slack replies/approvals are not implemented.
